```sql
with on_time_change as (
    select 
        year, 
        sum(on_time) as on_time_sum, 
        sum(scheduled) as scheduled_sum, 
        sum(on_time) / sum(scheduled) as on_time_ratio
    from 
        turnaround.mart_carrier_month 
    where 
        carrier = 'OO' and year between 2016 and 2020
    group by 
        year
)
select 
    (on_time_change.on_time_sum - on_time_change.scheduled_sum) * 100 / on_time_change.scheduled_sum as value
from 
    on_time_change
```
